homework_relevant_findings.finding: Annualized Sharpe uses sqrt(252)*mean(x)/sd(x); the course Sortino uses sqrt(252)*mean(x)/sd(x[x<0]). The latter is a conditional-negative-return standard deviation convention and differs from lower partial moment / PerformanceAnalytics defaults. Risk-free and target returns are zero in these examples.

Use log prices, trailing HighFreq::roll_mean(method="nonparametric") and roll_var(method="nonparametric"), lookback 3, Hampel z-score (log price minus rolling median)/MAD when MAD positive, otherwise zero. Set first lookback scores to zero. Threshold 1: score above 1 sets short, below -1 sets long, otherwise retain prior signal via na.locf. Initialize flat, lag once with rutils::lagit, multiply by log-price differences. Daily slide example excludes costs; intraday extension charges half bid-ask spread times absolute position change. A formula labeled Sharpe on slide 89 uses negative-return SD; use explicit course Sharpe formula and assignment expected values to resolve this slide typo.

calc_var(method="nonparametric") multiplies raw median absolute deviation by 1.4826, equivalent to stats::mad; fewer than three observations return zero. roll_var delegates each trailing, current-inclusive lookback subset to calc_var. With default step=1, lookb counts observations; e.g. lookb=3 is a three-observation window. Early windows expand. The Hampel slide independently forces the first lookb scores to zero.

Trailing one-sided filters use past/current data and are appropriate for real-time signals; centered filters advance the rolling statistics and use future observations. Do not copy centered price-cleaning examples into a trading backtest. Lag trade positions after constructing trailing signals.

Course documentation describes an EMA mean with decay lambda and a variance with decay lambda squared. Smaller lambda emphasizes recent returns and faster updating. run_var returns mean and variance columns; take square root of the second column for a univariate volatility. Course manual has old lambdaf argument; homework and installed package may use lambda. Match actual installed implementation when validating expected output.

Course distinguishes in-sample fitting/evaluation from held-out testing and warns that in-sample performance is optimistic. Homework lambda profiling over the full sample is in-sample parameter selection. Top-100 stock selection must depend only on Sharpe through 2016; evaluate following years separately. Whole-sample volatility matching is an ex-post plotting/comparison normalization, not a causal calibration protocol.

Readings motivate inverse-volatility exposure using persistent volatility and show that risk reduction and Sharpe benefits depend on assets, forecasting choices and turnover. Better volatility forecasts do not automatically imply better portfolio volatility control. Implementation assumptions and trading frictions matter.

Both syllabi contain standard NYU academic-integrity rules against fabrication, misattribution/plagiarism, and unauthorized collaboration on individually intended work. No course-specific AI rule or special homework collaboration authorization statement was found. Present methods and results truthfully and attribute course sources.
Local HTML is a small link page for an external LaTeX reference sheet; it does not contain a report template. Follow Homework 1 local report styling instead.

limitations: The preparatory review scans all document text and deeply inspects sections relevant to Homework 2. It is not a claim of reproducing or verifying every result in all 5,272 course-document pages.
